semantic_event_mapping.LOCK: native LOCK event records a piece placed into the board
semantic_event_mapping.LINE_CLEAR: native LINE_CLEAR event records rows removed after LOCK

assumptions: Exactly one public next-piece preview is exposed as preview[0].shape.
The preview reads the next native deterministic shape index without advancing the hidden sequence; no additional queue, bag, or RNG state is exposed.
Grounded lock counter increments once per simulation tick.
Clockwise matrix rotation has no wall kicks.
The deterministic piece set is a small seed-indexed shape list after the supplied active piece.
Source and usage budgets are unverified.

preview_contract.sequence: derived from the next native deterministic spawn index without advancing it
